name: Wordantle
summary: Wordantle is a free browser word game: find the secret word of the day by its meaning, not its spelling. Every guess shows how close you are, from cold to burning. Besides the daily Semantic puzzle, Pedantic hides a Wikipedia article, Cinemantic a film, Seriantic a TV series and Mangatic an anime or manga, revealed as you guess their words. Play solo, in a room with friends, or with your Twitch chat, in 11 languages.
